what: Putting the lifetime parts into the frozen head record failed at the first step: lifetimes.rs read signatures only through solved `&Names` (Resolver { names }, names.item_text), while freeze runs over `Records`, whose `solved()` is None. Its container lives were also keyed by library key, while an impl's head is filed by checker key, so an impl's ContainerLife had no home a seeded store could file it under.
cost: about an hour of reading before the first edit
cause: the lifetime reader was written for the old one-world front end and only tests called its Store accessors; production borrow check reads lifetimes from text (blaze_flow_lower read_signature)
whys: two readers of one signature's lifetimes (the store's and the flow lowerer's) with no record between them, so nothing forced the store's one onto the record path
class: a head part made by a reader bound to one names source: it silently cannot exist in a record built over the other
prevention: done: lifetimes.rs is generic over NamesSource (Paths { names }, text_of, home_of); container lives keyed by checker key; head_record form 10 holds every part made or refused. Left: the borrow check should read FnLife from the head record, not reparse text (one reader)
annoyance: the runner's ask moved to the background after 180 s though run in the foreground with a 600 s timeout
workaround: read the task's output file once it reported done
